messages:
nina: Heads-up — security-bot just flagged gaps in customer-facing audit events. Need a quick triage for API gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime so we can populate the backlog. Who can pair on a checklist?

alex: I can run the gateway & auth sweep. summary from the bot: 12 missing event types + schema mismatches.

security-bot: [automated] audit-validator: 12 missing events, 7 schema violations, sample service: api-gw. See /logs/audit-validator/2031234567 for details.

maya: quick note — billing has partial events but missing outcome codes and customer_id on some billing.transfer events. That breaks customer replay.

sam: for runtime (model + inference), we currently emit request.started and request.finished, but not key rotation / kms-access events. KMS integration questions: do we surface key_id in audit events or only an opaque token?

olivia: recommend key_id hashed (sha256) so we can map without leaking key metadata in customer copies. We discussed this in the KMS review doc.

nina: good. actionable approach: 1) enumerate missing event types per service 2) propose canonical schema v1 for customer-facing events 3) create backlog tickets with owners & acceptance criteria 4) run validator against canary logs.

alex: starting inventory now. Proposed lightweight canonical schema (single-line example):
```json
{"event_type":"string","timestamp":"rfc3339","actor":{"id":"string","type":"string"},"resource":{"id":"string","type":"string"},"outcome":{"success":true,"reason":"string"},"meta":{"service":"string","trace_id":"string"}}
```
Use this for customer-facing exports.

maya: agree on schema. billing-specific: add amount_cents (int) and currency for billing.transfer, and customer_id (hashed) when in a customer export.

sam: runtime additions: kms_access {"key_id_hash":"string","operation":"decrypt|encrypt|rotate"}, and model_version in resource.

security-bot: [automated] suggestion: tag all events with schema: audit.redwood.v1 so validator can filter.

nina: ok — let's split work. alex: api-gw + auth inventory + inline missing list (due EOD). maya: billing events + schema additions (due tomorrow). sam: runtime + KMS mapping (due EOD). olivia: update KMS guidance in docs and confirm hashing approach (due tomorrow). I'll open triage board items.

alex: initial notes: missing api-gw events -> token.create, token.revoke, oauth.callback, auth.policy.change, rbac.role.assign. Also some events use actor.email instead of actor.id. I'll standardize to actor.id.

maya: billing gaps -> invoice.created lacks customer_id, payment.failed uses outcome string not structured object. I'll draft patches.

sam: runtime gaps -> missing kms.access and model.permission.change. Also some request.finished events omit latency_ms. adding that as requirement.

nina: format for backlog tickets: service, event_type, delta (add/modify/remove), acceptance tests (validator rule + sample payload), owner, estimate. Example:
- ENGSEC-512: api-gw.token.create -> add event; validator rule: presence of actor.id, resource.id, outcome.success boolean; owner: alex; est: 2.

olivia: small UX note — customer-facing exports need opt-in for key metadata (even hashed). legal wants explicit consent. Add that to acceptance.

alex: ping @maya for any cross-service overlap on customer_id format — we should standardize hash salt method.

maya: agreed. will propose salt rotation policy in ticket.

security-bot: [automated] created issue ENGSEC-512 in tracker and attached failing samples.

nina: sweet. follow-up plan: we'll regroup tomorrow 10:30am. please drop samples into /shared/audit-samples/2031234567 and link in tickets. Any blockers?

sam: potential blocker: some runtime components log using legacy logger lib; need small refactor to include meta.trace_id — might be >1 sprint for fully automated rollout. I'll note that in ticket.

olivia: I'll surface the consent/legal note to product and add to the canary checklist.

alex: one more: need to ensure RBAC change events (role.assign/role.remove) include previous_role field to help replay for customers.

nina: good call. add previous_role to schema for rbac.* events.

maya: ok i'm adding notes to billing ticket now.

nina: thanks everyone. action summary pinned: alex (api-gw/auth inventory + ENGSEC-512), maya (billing patches + salt policy), sam (runtime + KMS events), olivia (KMS docs + legal), nina (triage board + meeting).

security-bot: [automated] next run scheduled in 24h.

alex: will post inventory snapshot when done. :thumbsup:
